### What changed

- **Zhipu Stepwise compatibility.** Fix connection tests for glm-4.5-air, glm-4.7, glm-4.6v and glm-4.1v-thinking-flashx through the official Zhipu API. Select Chat Completions and use https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4.
- **Clearer feedback.** Distinguish a missing direction identifier from a response that uses an unselected direction.
- **Development launch recovery.** Recover stale launch state after an abnormal exit only when the previous processes have stopped.

### 更新内容

- **智谱 Stepwise 兼容。** 修复通过智谱官方 API 使用 glm-4.5-air、glm-4.7、glm-4.6v 和 glm-4.1v-thinking-flashx 时的连接测试。选择 Chat Completions，地址为 https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4。
- **清晰反馈。** 区分未填写方向编号与返回未选方向的错误。
- **开发入口恢复。** 异常退出后，仅在旧进程已退出时恢复失效的启动状态。
